classification_meanings.PASSED_OFFLINE: Proven only within the named fictional/cooperating-local-process scope; not live/provider prevention.
classification_meanings.REQUIRES_CLI_OBSERVATION: Actual facts absent; proposed finite hosted acceptance tests require separate authority and a reviewed collector first.
classification_meanings.REQUIRES_OWNER_CONSENT: A decision or authority is missing; consent alone does not implement absent engineering or prove an observation.
classification_meanings.INTRINSIC_DISCLOSURE: Residual limitation remains in interpretation even if all empirical tests pass.

REQUIRES_CLI_OBSERVATION.acceptance: H2 diagnostic Q=4096 and H3 production Q=32768; no retries or invented notices; smaller-Q success is not production certification

REQUIRES_CLI_OBSERVATION.acceptance: Separately authorised checklist; drift/concurrency/unknown/default fallback stops all later tests; historical writer remains UNKNOWN

REQUIRES_CLI_OBSERVATION.required: Pinned actual binary/version/model and requested runtime settings, actual exit/wall evidence, no formatter/tools/skills/MCP/persistence or context reuse
REQUIRES_CLI_OBSERVATION.acceptance: No unsupported settings promoted to enforcement; collect actual evidence or keep UNKNOWN/BLOCKED

REQUIRES_OWNER_CONSENT.decision: Approve Path B formally, or remain blocked: 60000 is post-hoc, continuation may substantially overrun, visible generations do not enumerate provider work, privacy/model limitations remain.

Freeze common Q=32768 candidate or an explicit prospective alternative, generation/continuation/no-repair and run-stop/ordinary-format-failure rules, exact projection/order; ~20000 output remains guidance.
Separately authorise exact safe inspections, quiet window and at most H1-H3 once each, fixed fictional inputs/runtime/thresholds/stops, especially H3 overrun risk; no fourth probe or adaptive retry.

Commission and independently review a future gated collector binding the single approved journal/path/reservation namespace, exact package/runtime and consent, with durable raw spooling before evaluation.
Choose independently retained audit heads/checkpoints or explicitly accept trusted-local-filesystem limitations; no global tamper/rollback prevention claim without independent anchoring.

After gates, freeze all 12 new requests and obtain owner identity/date/hash-specific hosted-input consent. Independent human assessment and recorded actual effort remain mandatory; no AI attestation or successful-card-only comparison.

INTRINSIC_DISCLOSURE.limitation: No supported aggregate upper bound over unseen scaffolding/requests/output; best-effort cancellation and post-hoc stops cannot undo consumption.
Underlying provider request count/context, independent usage completeness, immutable weights/build and actual effort are not certified by finite visible-event tests.
Tokens and CLI list-price estimates are not actual subscription charges; unattributable charges remain UNKNOWN.

Local log/witness copies cannot independently authenticate coordinated deletion/rollback, cloned directories, all power-loss durability or malicious filesystem writers; trusted external checkpoints would change that assurance scope, not provider visibility.
Sampled stat/process stability does not establish content equality, every transient process or writer causation; historical writer UNKNOWN and leakage NOT_ESTABLISHED.

Three attempts per condition, partial blinding, residual time/order and HYBRID lane-round confounding, lane-dependent input/output headroom and consumption differences restrict conclusions to descriptive workflows. Fictional success supplies no scientific result.
